issue.title: frees-marks 200-link/2000-task 25ms wall-clock budget flakes under parallel suite load
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-im.4 note #1: scripts/test-ledger-tools-frees-marks.cjs 200-link/2000-task build measured 187 ms against 25 ms during full npm test, then passed 17/17 in isolation on its unchanged tree. Landing control on bob-plugins aaece06 passes all 17 frees-mark tests alongside snippet/MEET suites (80/80 total). Source lines 481-509, introduced by closed epic g1 commit 4ec76dc, measure one warm sample with RealDate.now(), so scheduler delay under suite load counts as algorithm time. Keep the deterministic 200-row, one-resolution, one-count assertions and a meaningful performance regression gate; isolate or stabilize the measurement without blindly raising the 25 ms target. Small: bounded test-harness measurement repair with known single-sample wall-clock cause. All-status searches and last-week sweep found no same-node task; f8 concerns distinct CPU-timed task-wikilink ranking/snapshot tests, though its notes mention this secondary flake. No active epic causally owns the frees-mark test.

task_type_fields.evidence: Phase bob-cli-im.4 note #1: one reported full-suite failure at 187ms >25ms, followed by isolated 17/17 pass on unchanged tree; denominator unspecified. Lander on aaece06: focused 80/80 pass including this file. No new full-suite failure claimed.
